text: Naledi's driving test is on May 14 at 10:40. She's failed it twice already, once on the roundabouts and once on a reverse park, and is properly nervous this time. Her instructor thinks she's ready. She's booked two extra lessons that week, including one the day before. Text her good luck the night before, and ask how it went the next afternoon.
Pick up the dry cleaning and drop the parcel at the post office before Thursday.

Sunil's daughter starts reception on September 3rd. He says she's been wearing her new uniform around the house all weekend, and refuses to take the book bag off even at dinner. He and his wife are both taking the morning off for the first day, then his mum is doing pickups for the rest of the week. He's acting relaxed but I think he's more emotional about it than he lets on.
Rana passed her grade 8 piano! Results came through this morning. She's already talking about the diploma next year.
Rahul has his final law exams in June. His mum told me he's barely sleeping and living on energy drinks. I should check in with him a week after they finish.
Car MOT is booked for 6/12, 9am. Need to clear the boot out the day before.

Tobi's graduation is July 8th in Manchester. His parents are flying over from Lagos for it and staying the whole week afterwards, so he's frantically cleaning the flat and trying to find somewhere decent for dinner that evening. He finished with a first in civil engineering and starts a graduate job at Arup in September. Very proud of him.
Mustafa auditioned for the youth orchestra on Saturday. He finds out on 4/30. Ask him how he got on once the letters are out.
Keisha and her husband Marcus are both doing the Open University graduation on May 22. Very sweet, they studied together for six years.
Hana mentioned her son Kenji is sitting his eleven plus in September. She's more stressed than he is, honestly.
Finally booked my theory test. March 18, 2:30. Revising on the app every evening until then.
Farid's GCSE results day is August 21st. Don't forget to message him that morning.
Finn has the lead in the school play, which is on June 5th and 6th. His dad Ravi said he's been rehearsing lines in the car every day.
Kiara got into Edinburgh for medicine! Mrs Novak was practically in tears telling me at the school gate.
Marcus says the bar exam has been moved to February 24. He's relieved to have more time. He likes bouldering and goes three nights a week to keep his head clear.
Saanvi's little one takes her first swimming badge test next Tuesday. Saanvi's going to film it for the grandparents.
Mohammed's brother Rahul graduates from Leeds on July 15th. The family is doing a big dinner the evening after.
Tadhg's citizenship test was cancelled because the centre flooded. No new date yet.
Hemi is nervous about her viva on June 3rd. She's been working on that thesis for five years. Send her something nice the day before, maybe flowers.

Need to renew my passport before the summer. Photos first, then the form at the post office. The current one runs out on 7/2 and the flights are on July 19th, so there isn't much slack. If it hasn't come back by the end of June, pay for the fast track service and book an appointment for the week after.
Sinead's twins start secondary school on 9/4. One is thrilled, the other is dreading it.
Rachel's driving test went well, she passed first time! Took her mum out for lunch afterwards. Should send her a congratulations card.

Zara is applying to drama schools. Her first audition is at RADA on January 12th, then Guildhall a week after, and LAMDA at some point in February. She's doing a Shakespeare piece and something modern she won't tell anyone about. Her mum says she rehearses in the bath. She keeps mentioning wanting a decent monologue book, which could be a good birthday present.
Aarav lost his first tooth today. Apparently the tooth fairy is expected to pay well in this house.
Kieran's son finishes nursery on July 18th. They're having a little leavers' party that afternoon.
Called Ines about her nursing exams. She sits the last one on May 9 and has a week off afterwards. She's been really anxious and isn't eating much. Remind me to ring her the day after it's done.
Layla said the dance recital is the Saturday after Easter. Her daughter has a solo and has been practising in the kitchen every night.
Santiago passed his citizenship interview. He's been waiting nearly two years for this.
Björn's PhD graduation is on November 30th in Uppsala. He invited me but I won't be able to make it. Must post a card in good time, ideally by mid-November.
Grocery list for the weekend: eggs, oat milk, coffee, bin bags. Also need to return the library books.
Alfie, or Alf as everyone calls him, finally got his black belt. The grading was last Sunday.
Jada starts her teacher training placement on 10/6. She's a bit worried about behaviour management.
Alana's results come out on August 14th. She's hoping for AAB to get into Bristol for vet science. Don't forget to text her that morning, and again the next day once the dust settles.
Mr Hughes said his granddaughter is taking her ballet grade 5 exam next month.
Naledi passed her driving test! Need to send her a congrats message and maybe a keyring for her first car.
I'm taking the boys to their swimming lessons on Saturdays from now on. Starts this week.
Sunil mentioned his wife is retaking her accountancy exam on March 3rd. She missed the pass mark by two points last time. He's taking the kids to his mum's that weekend so she can revise.
Rana's son starts at the big school next week. He's been asking if they have a chess club. He's obsessed with chess.
Dentist moved to April 2nd at 4:15. Book the afternoon off work.

Keisha's daughter has her ice skating competition on February 8th. Keisha's driving her up to Sheffield the day before, and Marcus is following on the morning of with the dog, a very anxious spaniel called Biscuit. She's nervous because she fell at the last one. I should text Keisha that evening to see how it went.
Tobi said his sister Alana is doing her driving test the week after his graduation. Big month for the Osei family.
Mustafa's in! Got the letter today. First rehearsal is on 5/17.
Kenji has his violin grade 3 exam on June 12. Hana said he plays best in the morning, so she asked for an early slot.
Finn's school play went brilliantly by all accounts. Ask Ravi for the video.

Hemi's viva was postponed again, this time to August 2nd. She's fed up. Her external examiner is ill and the department only told her two days before the original date. She'd already printed everything and booked a celebratory dinner with her partner for that evening. She says she's going to keep reading over the summer but honestly she sounds exhausted.
Rahul is a big Arsenal fan and plays five-a-side on Wednesdays.
Farid got 9s in maths and physics! He's off to sixth form at Hollybrook in September. Should get him a little something to celebrate, maybe a decent calculator, he joked his is falling apart.

Mohammed's mum is having knee surgery on June 20th, the same week as Rahul's graduation. He's worried she won't be able to go, and she's insisting she will even if it means a wheelchair. The surgeon said no stairs for at least two weeks afterwards. I should ask Mohammed if they need help with lifts that week, I'm free most evenings.

Ironing tonight, then prep lunches for the week. Tomorrow: bank first thing, then the tip with the old chest of drawers, then the garden centre for compost. Saturday morning is the big supermarket shop. Sunday I'm finally clearing the spare room before the new bed arrives on the 28th. It needs to be empty the day before so the delivery guys can get in.
Zara's Guildhall recall is on February 2nd. Her mum Mrs Evans says she's thrilled but terrified. Text Zara good luck that morning.
Tadhg's new citizenship test date is December 9th. Wish him luck the day before.
Saanvi said her youngest passed her swimming badge and insisted on wearing it to bed.
Kiara's leaving do is on August 29th, the week before she heads up to Edinburgh. Her boyfriend Kieran is organising it.
Sinead said the quieter twin has settled in much better than expected. She's joined the art club.
Booked the car in for a service on 11/3. Leave by eight that morning to beat traffic.
Mrs Johnson mentioned Jada did her first solo teaching day and loved it. Jada is vegetarian, worth remembering for the end of placement drinks on December 12th.
Santiago's ceremony is on May 28th at the town hall. His husband Björn is making a cake for afterwards.
Sort out the gutter cleaning before the storms hit.
Ines passed all her exams. Her sister Naledi told me before Ines even could. Message Ines tonight.
Layla's son Aarav has his first day at nursery on Monday. She's dreading it more than he is. Check in with her on Monday afternoon, and then again at the end of the week to see how he's settling.
